name: zeffect_init_from_path
description: zEffect::InitFromPath loads an effect template ZRD, resolves template model nodes, binds graphics data, initializes cycle-texture metadata, creates the runtime free list, and marks the runtime manager initialized.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zEffect init/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x460070 validates the already-initialized early return, zReader::LoadNodeFromPath failure path, EFFECTS array template count, calloc of zEffect_RuntimeEntry records, parent/listener assignment, per-template model/name/MAPS/SPEED/LOOPING parsing, zClass bucket-6 template lookup, FindNodeUserDataRecursive graphics-data binding, pick/raycast/active disabling, StoreInt32 graphics-data marker write, cycle texture count/speed/loop setup, map texture append loop, TexDir_LoadPendingEntries, free-list creation, initialized flag store, and zero success return.

The native init-from-path smoke builds a mounted effect.zrd archive with one template, resolves a bucket-6 model node with material graphics data, verifies runtime manager fields, template name/effect name binding, graphics data binding, cycle speed and looping setup, free-list creation, and initialized state.
